name: FortiGate
description: FortiGate automation showcase: golden config compliance, interface configuration, and backup/config snapshot.

document.name: FortiGate Interface Config
document.template:
config system interface
    edit "{{ interface }}"
        set ip {{ ip_address }} {{ subnet_mask }}
        set allowaccess {{ allowaccess }}
        set description "{{ description }}"
    next
end
document.description: Renders a FortiGate interface configuration block (IP, allowed management access, description).

document.name: FortiGate Interface Delete
document.description: Resets a FortiGate interface's IP, allowed management access, and description back to unconfigured.

config system interface
    edit "{{ interface }}"
        unset ip
        unset allowaccess
        unset description
    next
end
